blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls face powerhouse Japan on Saturday to begin their quest for a first-ever medal finish in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 women’s softball at Anjo City Comprehensive Sports Park. The Blu Girls will be heavy underdogs in the 2:15 p.m. Manila time match as they aim to atone for their heartbreaking fourth place finish at the pandemic-delayed 2022 Hangzhou edition held three years ago.
